name: diffusion
about: Diffusion MRI for brain tumor planning: reading diffusion data from every major scanner, FA and Color FA, distortion correction, UKF two-tensor free-water tractography on the graphics card, tract names from RapidParc, the tracts near a tumor.
assetsNote: Each group lands in the app at vendor/diffusion/<group>/ (the SDK's assetUrl). The licenses travel with the built app: the UKF license requires its terms in every copy, source and executable (LICENSE-UKF.txt, part B 1(b)).
